description: A waveshaper built from Chebyshev polynomials, which turns a sine wave into a chosen set of harmonics

params.text: Sets how much of the signal is fed into the shaper, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the Lvl jack before it is added to the Lvl knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The signal to be shaped, one per channel
Sets the strength of each harmonic, one channel per harmonic counting up from the first, 10V for full strength; with nothing patched a built-in set of seven is used
Modulates that amount, a tenth per volt scaled by the Lvl CV knob

outputs.text: The shaped signal with its constant offset removed

notes: the signal is soft clipped before the shaping, so a signal driven far past 5V is rounded off rather than running away
the harmonics come out as written only for a sine wave at the input; any other shape gives its own harmonics through the same polynomials

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads a built-in set of seven strengths.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
